name: Chario
source:
A paladin of the Order of the Silver Castle.
A decade ago, her father, the Master of the Order, perished.
She walked the same path her father trod and is now the Order Master just as her father was. Extremely strict and stubborn, she's currently searching for a powerful magical artefact which was lost by the Order inside the Tower.

A paladin of the Order of the Silver Castle.
